vulnerable_code:
# app/views/orders/show.json.jbuilder
json.extract! @order, :id, :order_number, :delivery_status, :created_at

# Association leakage: exposes patient medical prescriptions and national IDs to delivery couriers
json.prescriptions @order.prescriptions do |prescription|
  json.id prescription.id
  json.medication_name prescription.medication_name
  json.dosage prescription.dosage
  json.patient_national_id prescription.patient_national_id
end
diagnosis: The Jbuilder template renders full prescription details on delivery orders without scoping visibility to medical staff or the patient. Delivery courier accounts viewing package fulfillment routes receive sensitive patient psychiatric prescriptions and national identity numbers.
exploit_request:
GET /api/pharmacy/orders/ord_5521.json HTTP/1.1
Host: logistics.e-pharmacy.health
Authorization: Bearer courier_access_token_881
Accept: application/json
corrected_code:
# app/views/orders/show.json.jbuilder
json.extract! @order, :id, :order_number, :delivery_status, :created_at

if current_user.physician? || current_user.id == @order.patient_user_id
  json.prescriptions @order.prescriptions do |prescription|
    json.id prescription.id
    json.medication_name prescription.medication_name
    json.dosage prescription.dosage
    json.patient_national_id prescription.patient_national_id
  end
end
